title: Form, recover and disband a fleet
description: Four independent commanders enter through actual authenticated controls. Formation reserves forces, leased settlement moves them once, and disband returns them once. Owner and other-player views show private orders and outcomes. Fixed catalogue/domain clocks are explicit harness controls. Development transport capacity and tick rules remain under review; this does not certify travel, managed encryption or hosted scheduling.

steps.description: Open each commander's own fleet preparation. Enter two fighters and an over-capacity infantry complement before committing anything.

Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.
Invalid input does not change canonical state or reserve forces.

steps.description: Confirm formation with Enter. The authoritative receipt reserves two fighters and twenty infantry for tick one, without moving them yet.
steps.acknowledgement: The service acknowledges the formation and publishes its exact waiting complement.
verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.
One accepted receipt and revision reserve the original forces without creating a fleet or moving the garrison.

steps.description: Advance the explicit domain clock once and invoke the real leased tick service. Repeat delivery must do no work; no fleet or outcome is injected.

steps.description: Read the authoritative formation result and select the new fleet with the keyboard. The other commander still sees only their own forces.
steps.acknowledgement: The confirmed fleet contains two fighters and twenty infantry and can be disbanded.
verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.

steps.description: Return to the actual galaxy and inspect the stationed fleet marker.

verifications: Navigation preserves canonical forces and the independent player's empty roster.

steps.description: Reopen the stationed fleet and confirm disbanding with Enter. Forces stay aboard until tick two is acknowledged.
steps.acknowledgement: The actual disband receipt queues the unchanged complement for tick two.
verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.
Exactly one revision and order are added; no forces return before settlement.

steps.description: Reload the accepted disband order before settlement.

verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.

steps.description: Deliver the second boundary through the real leased service, then repeat it. Production and disband are real reducer outcomes; this is not hosted cadence evidence.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Read the confirmed disband result and returned home-system forces.
steps.acknowledgement: The fleet has disbanded, its order has cleared, and formation is available again.
verifications: Both fixed action rails are visible before scrolling and no application error occurred.
Other commanders have no owner fleet, private order or ledger in their actual member projections.

steps.description: Reload the settled result and return to the galaxy with the keyboard.

verifications: Final reload and navigation preserve the exact settled state and no application errors occurred.
